## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that fails without the change
- [ ] Persisted-format changes bump `CURRENT_SCHEMA` and add an upcaster test
- [ ] Public-interface changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes have a property test and update `docs/security.md`
- [ ] No secrets, no new dependencies without justification
